items.title: What Does Nike (NKE) Gain From Its Victor Wembanyama Signature Shoe Bet?
items.summary: Nike (NYSE:NKE) has made a major investment in Victor Wembanyama that includes a new signature basketball shoe line. The company is positioning Wembanyama as a central figure in its push toward the NBA's next generation of stars. This move adds a fresh angle to Nike's basketball marketing approach as it manages challenges in markets such as China. This kind of focus on emerging athletes is not unique to Nike.
